evidence: HtmlUtils cookie getter is independent of generic XHR request helpers; script loader uses YouTube iframe API.
Ide3 generated loops terminate through break, return, or throw; reload is a separate function and beforeunload is cleared.
Native executable contains Electron/Chromium node integration and passkey protocol schemas, not cross-process credential harvesting.
Benchmark code is string-valued evaluation input with expectedRuleIds, not automatically executed payloads.
CI publish permissions and token references are normal release automation.
SKILL.md quotes separate fenced PHP webshell and GIF upload examples, not a Honker family payload.
C2 listeners and webshell manager are explicit testing features; no hidden victim or exfiltration target is bundled.
Installer downloads official linPEAS and installs mode 0755.
PTRACE_TRACEME and DirtyCow are entries in a CVE prerequisites table.
Printed log filenames are colorized with sed; system logs are not rewritten.
Public /dev/tcp requests test connectivity; optional forwarding relays operator-selected ports.
Secret-pattern searches print local audit results. Optional external vulnerability lookup is explicitly documented and opt-in.
